services.hero.label: Our services

services.cards.title: Structural work
services.cards.desc: Demolition, layout changes, new plaster, floors, ceilings, and full construction work.

services.cards.title: Electrical installation
services.cards.desc: New wiring, sockets, switches, lighting, and preparation for modern technology.

services.cards.title: Plumbing and heating
services.cards.desc: Water supply, waste lines, heating, and bathroom installations including underfloor heating.

services.cards.title: Kitchens and bathrooms
services.cards.desc: Design, manufacture and installation of kitchens, bathrooms and custom fitted furniture.

services.cards.title: Doors and interiors
services.cards.desc: Interior and entrance doors, cladding, wallpapers and other design details.

services.cards.title: Surfaces and design
services.cards.desc: Tiles, flooring, painting and final finishes that create the right atmosphere.

services.details.title: Interior design
services.details.desc: Every project begins with a deep understanding of your needs, lifestyle and aesthetic preferences. We prepare complete project documentation including layouts, 3D visualizations and material selection - everything so the result is truly yours.

services.details.title: Turnkey renovation
services.details.desc: We coordinate all trades from demolition to final cleaning. We work with trusted professionals and supervise quality at every stage. You do not need to worry about anything.

services.details.title: Custom furniture
services.details.desc: We design and manufacture custom furniture that combines functionality, quality materials and timeless design. Every piece is created with regard to your space, needs and lifestyle.

services.details.title: Showroom
services.details.desc: Visit our showroom in Prague's Smíchov district and explore materials, samples, and project showcases. Our designers will be happy to advise you and design the interior together with you according to your exact preferences.
